meta.rule: RECOMMENDED CONSUMER settlement vocabulary. OddsLogic officially claims 'event and prop grading feeds' exist but discloses NO states, enums, void rules, or correction semantics. Nothing here is vendor behavior.
meta.oddslogic_official_grading_disclosure: none beyond the phrase 'event and prop grading feeds' and 'real-time game and prop grading'

state_rules.trigger: cancellation, no-action rule, listed-pitcher change (book-specific), player scratch under book minimum-participation rules
state_rules.warning: book-specific and provider-specific — never assume universal rules

state_rules.trigger: Asian quarter lines: half stake on adjacent lines

state_rules.payout: stake divided by number of tied winners (book-specific)

state_rules.requirement: consumer ledger must be append-only: new grade row supersedes, never overwrites

edge_fixtures.name: mlb_doubleheader
edge_fixtures.scenario: same teams, same date, two events
edge_fixtures.requirement: game_number in event key; grades must attach to the correct game

edge_fixtures.name: postponed_resumed
edge_fixtures.requirement: tombstone+relink; open quotes marked stale; book action/no-action rules govern void

edge_fixtures.name: pitcher_change
edge_fixtures.requirement: listed-pitcher bets void or re-price per book rule; flag all pre-change quotes

edge_fixtures.name: ot_semantics
edge_fixtures.scenario: regulation-only vs OT-inclusive market same event
edge_fixtures.requirement: ot_inclusion in market key metadata; UNKNOWN for OddsLogic — onboarding question

edge_fixtures.name: stat_correction_prop
edge_fixtures.requirement: prop regrade emitted; downstream consumers must re-settle

edge_fixtures.name: dst_boundary
edge_fixtures.requirement: store UTC instant + venue tz; never key on ambiguous local time

edge_fixtures.name: out_of_order_updates
edge_fixtures.scenario: quote with earlier source_timestamp arrives after later one
edge_fixtures.requirement: order by (source_timestamp, ingest_sequence); never last-write-wins on arrival order

edge_fixtures.name: invalid_odds
edge_fixtures.requirement: reject at ingest, quarantine payload (see odds-formulas-test-vectors.json invalid_input_behavior)
